dedupe_keys.name: deepowt v4 25 1 deep learning derived dense sentinel 1 time series for offshore wind infrastructure

description: DeepOWT, produced by researchers at the German Aerospace Center, maps offshore wind infrastructure and its deployment through Sentinel-1 radar observations. Version 4.25.1 contains 15,606 global infrastructure locations and dense time series spanning 2016Q1–2025Q1. Parquet tables distinguish spatial locations, temporal observations and training samples. Observation intervals depend on available acquisitions, approximately one to twelve days. Event classes distinguish water, vessels, platforms, foundations, construction and deployed turbines; deployment flags mark inferred construction transitions. Zenodo distributes these tables in an open ZIP archive under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Location-validation polygons cover the North Sea Basin, East China Sea and southeast Vietnam, not every mapped region. The labels are inferred from imagery and are not an operator-certified asset register. Modellers could combine the locations with storm exposure or use deployment dates to construct changing offshore generation scenarios. Related inventories include data-ea-owt-east-asia-offshore-wind-turbines and data-global-renewables-watch-solar-wind. The 2022 ESSD paper describes an earlier release of the same resource; version-specific coverage must be preserved.
